title: Reload firewall configuration
summary: Apply permanent firewall changes immediately and discard any unsaved runtime changes.

steps.explain: Reload firewalld to force the permanent configuration to take effect and lose any runtime changes.

rollback.explain: If you lost runtime changes you wanted to keep, you must re-apply them manually.

warnings: This discards any temporary rules you added without --permanent.
Ensure you have saved important changes with --runtime-to-permanent if needed.
